input.quote: (a) In the event the Company terminates this Agreement, the Company shall pay to HDI a termination payment, (the "Termination Payment") the amount of which shall be an amount equal to the aggregate Net Sales for the twelve (12) months preceding the Termination Date less $800,000, the balance of which shall be divided by two.
input.rationale: Section 4.2 imposes a stipulated, Company-payable early-termination amount: 50% of trailing twelve-month Net Sales above $800,000, triggered by any Company termination. Because our fees under Section 3.1 are only 30% of Net Sales above $11,000 per month, this formula routinely exceeds a year's fees, so it fails the fallback of an early-termination fee capped at 3 months' fees as the sole liquidated amount. We therefore add a lesser-of cap at 3 months' Section 3.1 fees and state that the Termination Payment is the sole liquidated amount payable by the Company on termination.

ops.oldText: the amount of which shall be an amount equal to the aggregate Net Sales for the twelve (12) months preceding the Termination Date less $800,000, the balance of which shall be divided by two.
ops.newText: the amount of which shall be an amount equal to the lesser of (i) the aggregate Net Sales for the twelve (12) months preceding the Termination Date less $800,000, the balance of which shall be divided by two, and (ii) 3 months' fees payable by the Company under Section 3.1.

ops.text: The Termination Payment shall be the sole liquidated amount payable by the Company by reason of termination of this Agreement.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] We have added a lesser-of limb capping the Termination Payment at 3 months' fees payable under Section 3.1, and confirmed it is the sole liquidated amount payable by the Company on termination; a payment measured as half of trailing twelve-month Net Sales can far exceed the fees we pay HDI.
proposal.summary: Cap the Company-payable Termination Payment at 3 months' fees and make it the sole liquidated amount

mappings.element: Customer-payable liquidated amount limited to an early-termination fee.
Early-termination fee capped at 3 months' fees.
